translations.client.module.backtrack.desc: Shows where players were a moment ago so you can aim at their past position on servers with lag compensation.
translations.client.module.backtrack.fakeLatency.desc: Holds your outgoing movement and attack packets back by this long, so the server sees you where you were instead of where you are. Incoming traffic is untouched, so your own view stays current. Expect rubber-banding at high values, exactly like real high ping.
translations.client.module.backtrack.fakeLatency.name: Fake Latency
Pins every ghost box where it was the moment you enabled this, instead of letting it follow the enemy. Combine with Stack Latency Offset to test whether the server still accepts a hit on a position it stopped updating.
translations.client.module.backtrack.ghostCount.desc: How many ghost boxes to spread between the live model and the full window. Each one is separately aimable, and hitting one retimes the attack to that box age automatically. Needs Only Last Record off.
translations.client.module.backtrack.ghostCount.name: Ghost Count

translations.client.module.backtrack.hitbox.name: Lag Record Hitbox

translations.client.module.backtrack.hitboxStyle.name: Hitbox Style
The thickness of the lag record hitbox outline.
translations.client.module.backtrack.name: Backtrack
translations.client.module.backtrack.invalidateAirbor: Records taken while the enemy was off the ground cannot be attacked by Aimbot, Triggerbot, or your own clicks. The boxes are still drawn so you can see them, they just are not valid targets. Judged per record from the moment it was taken, not from where the enemy is now.
translations.client.module.backtrack.onlyLastRecord.d: Only use a real recorded position at exactly the configured age. Off, positions between two records are reconstructed so any age is aimable, which is smoother and lets you hit ages the 20ms record interval never landed on.
translations.client.module.backtrack.throughWalls.des: Draw the lag record hitbox through walls.
translations.client.module.backtrack.stackLatencyDela: Subtracts this value from the NetworkStackLatency timestamp so the server measures a higher ping than you actually have. Your input is never delayed, so movement and chests stay instant while the server rewinds further back for your hits.
translations.client.module.backtrack.stopFakeLatencyW: Stop Fake Latency when you try to open a loot container and keep it stopped while the container screen is open.
Stop Fake Latency while eating, drinking, blocking, or charging a bow, crossbow, trident, or other held-use item.
